stories.title: DLI-backed C2i Semiconductors raises $15 million from Peak XV, marking largest funding round for Indian chip startup - D
Matters AI raises Rs 115 crore
stories.summary: Data security startup Matters AI has raised Rs 115 crore in a round led by Tanglin Venture Partners. The company, which builds what it calls an AI Security Engineer for Data, says this is the largest pre-series A raise by an Indian cybersecurity startup. It tracks sensitive data.

stories.title: AidenAI raises $32 million in Series A
stories.summary: Enterprise AI startup AidenAI has raised $32 million in its maiden institutional funding round led by A91 Partners. Founded by former Infosys executive Srinivas Kamadi, the company works with over 30 enterprise clients to accelerate digital transformation. It plans to expand its platform for deploying AI across legacy systems.

stories.title: Cosine Robots raises Rs 22 crore for actuators
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based Cosine Robots has raised Rs 22.36 crore to manufacture robotic actuators. The company describes these components as muscles and joints for robots, controlling movement and precision. The capital will fund a research and production facility to scale the development of systems for robotic arms and humanoids.

stories.title: Ionic Wealth Raises ₹1,770 Crore in Strategic Funding from Angel One and Business Families - Indian Startup Times
Zavya raises Rs 22.6 crore in pre-Series A
stories.summary: Everyday silver jewellery brand Zavya has raised Rs 22.6 crore in a pre-Series A round, valuing the company at Rs 191.5 crore. The digital-first retailer focuses on contemporary 925 sterling silver designs. It reports achieving EBITDA profitability while scaling its operations across India.

stories.title: Vegapay to raise Rs 38.4 crore in Series A
stories.summary: Digital lending platform Vegapay is set to raise Rs 38.4 crore in a Series A round led by Prosus. The company builds card management solutions for banks and regulated entities. Existing investors Elevation Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Eximius Ventures also participated in the round.

stories.title: Cosine Robots raises ₹22.36 crore to manufacture robotic joints in India
stories.summary: The Avaana Capital-led funding round will help Cosine Robots scale its R&D and production facility for actuators that power machines ranging from robotic arms to humanoids. stories.title: Thorium reactor startup SUK-M raises pre-seed round
stories.summary: SUK-M has raised a pre-seed round led by Speciale Invest to develop a thorium-based micro-modular nuclear reactor. The company aims to move from simulations to laboratory testing for a 10 MW electricity or 30 MW heat unit. It describes itself as India's first venture in this technology.

stories.title: Agon raises $70 million for synthetic battle arena
stories.summary: Defence AI startup Agon has raised $70 million at a $450 million valuation. The company does not make weapons, but builds a synthetic battle arena to train and validate autonomous defence systems. It says real-world exercises cannot recreate the thousands of threat scenarios required for modern battlefield testing.

stories.title: Ramon.Space raises $124 million in Series B
stories.summary: Ramon.Space has raised $124 million in Series B funding led by PSG to increase production of its onboard space computing systems. The company builds hardware designed to operate under radiation and power limits in orbit. Demand for processing data in space is rising as satellite constellations expand.

stories.title: Dulo raises $130 million seed round
stories.summary: AI startup Dulo has raised $130 million to build what it calls an engineering superintelligence. Founded by Sebastian Thrun and Adrian Aoun, the company aims to use foundation models for hardware design. It seeks to apply AI to physical product development in the same way it has for software.

stories.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24M in Seed Funding - FinSMEs
Iliad Partners closes first fund at $33.4 million
stories.summary: UAE-based venture capital firm Iliad Partners has closed its first fund at $33.4 million. The final close included commitments from the Hellenic Development Bank of Investments and Alpha Bank. The fund's limited partners now include sovereign investors and several major Greek banks.

stories.title: Eleven secures €57 million for fourth fund
stories.summary: Eleven has reached a €57 million first close for its fourth venture capital fund, targeting a total of €100 million. The firm plans to back pre-seed and seed-stage companies across Europe. The European Investment Fund returned as an anchor investor for the third time.

stories.title: CommerzVentures launches €50m seed and Series A-focused Fund IV - FinTech Futures
Redalpine closes $250 million fund
stories.summary: Swiss venture capital firm Redalpine has closed a $250 million fund to invest in European deep-technology companies. The firm is currently exploring a strategic corridor between Europe and the UAE for startups in artificial intelligence, energy, and health. It completed the raise during a difficult market environment.

stories.title: Data security startup Matters.AI raises ₹115 crore in pre-Series A round
stories.summary: Led by Tanglin Venture Partners, the funding round takes Matters.AI's total capital raised to Rs 175 crore and will support R&D and expansion of its North American sales operations Listen to This Article Enterprise data security startup Matters.AI has raised Rs 115 crore in a pre-Series A round led by

stories.title: Aeravti Ventures Announces First Close of ₹300 Crore Fund II, Secures Over Half of Target Corpus in Commitments - Indian
VU Venture Partners expands to India
stories.summary: US-based VU Venture Partners is bringing its venture-capital accelerator to India, targeting early-stage startups with investments of $100,000 to $1 million. The firm plans to combine investor training through its Venture University with access to its global network. The university was established in 2018.

stories.title: VU Venture Partners enters Indian market
stories.summary: VU Venture Partners, an early investor in OpenAI and SpaceX, has entered the Indian startup ecosystem. The firm plans to deploy funds through a syndicate of over 8,000 accredited investors, targeting seed and Series A rounds. It aims to build a portfolio across nine sectors.

stories.title: CortexSpark Ventures targets ₹1,000 crore fund
stories.summary: CortexSpark Ventures has launched its debut fund, Viksit Bharat Fund-I, targeting a ₹1,000 crore corpus to back Indian deeptech and AI startups. The fund includes a ₹400 crore greenshoe option. The firm plans to invest in approximately 20 startups at $4 million to $5 million each.

stories.title: Recast Capital adds Latin American managers to cohort
stories.summary: Recast Capital has selected 17 venture funds for its fourth annual development program, including participants from Latin America and the Caribbean for the first time. The program provides shared services and executive coaching to help emerging managers build institutional firms. The expansion follows a new three-year partnership.

stories.title: Kaszek Raises $650 Million Fund for Latin America’s AI Startups - Bloomberg
Key1 Capital raises $320 million second fund
stories.summary: Israeli venture capital firm Key1 Capital is raising a $320 million second fund, reaching an initial close ahead of schedule. The firm reports a 20.6% net internal rate of return for its four-year-old debut fund. Industry estimates place the capital returned to investors at a 0.35-0.4 ratio.

stories.title: AAY Investments Group receives industry recognition
stories.summary: AAY Investments Group has been named Top Venture Capital Fund Service 2026 by Financial Services Review. The publication selected the firm based on its published evaluation methodology. The recognition highlights the company's approach to international project funding, including direct lending and structured private capital solutions.

stories.title: PhonePe revives IPO plans
stories.summary: PhonePe has resumed its IPO process, targeting a stock market listing in February or March at a valuation of $12-15 billion. The digital payments company plans to raise up to 14,000 crore rupees through an offer-for-sale. It previously deferred the listing due to market volatility.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to depart
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down after more than 11 years with the e-commerce company. During his tenure, the business grew more than fivefold. Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the organization in the interim while the company searches for a successor.

stories.title: Oxyzo reports 19 percent profit growth
stories.summary: Oxyzo Financial Services reported a 19 percent increase in standalone net profit to 208.2 crore rupees for the first half of FY27. Operating revenue grew 28.4 percent to 874.9 crore rupees. Interest income remains the primary contributor to the firm's earnings, despite a decline in fee income.

stories.title: PayU India reports adjusted EBITDA profit
stories.summary: PayU India swung to an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 million in the first half of FY27, compared to a $1 million loss in the year-ago period. Revenue declined 3.3 percent to $384 million, though the company noted growth in local currency and transaction volumes.

stories.title: Swish reports FY26 revenue and losses
stories.summary: Quick delivery startup Swish reported operating revenue of 47.6 crore rupees for FY26, while net losses widened to 91 crore rupees. Founded in 2024, the company operates in-house kitchens and offers 250 items across 20 categories. It currently services 50 pincodes.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO to exit as IPO remains uncertain
stories.summary: Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down as CEO of Flipkart on 4 December after 11 years. His departure follows ongoing uncertainty regarding the company's long-awaited IPO, with parent company Walmart prioritizing profitability. Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the organization in the interim.

stories.title: Balaji Thiagarajan named interim Flipkart CEO
stories.summary: Flipkart chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan has been appointed interim CEO following the departure of Kalyan Krishnamurthy. Krishnamurthy led the company through its acquisition by Walmart and years of preparations for a potential public listing. A permanent successor will be named in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy steps down
stories.summary: Kalyan Krishnamurthy is leaving Flipkart after 11 years as CEO. He oversaw the company during its acquisition by Walmart and subsequent efforts to prepare for a stock market debut. Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the firm in the interim while the board searches for a permanent replacement.

stories.title: Flipkart leadership transition follows CEO exit
stories.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy is stepping down after nearly a decade in the role. The company confirmed the departure following an internal town hall. Chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan and the board will lead the organization until a successor is announced in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Gen Z entrepreneurship rises in India
stories.summary: The number of young professionals adding founder to their LinkedIn profiles has increased 383 percent since 2022. Data indicates that 94 percent of Gen Z respondents in India aspire to start their own businesses, with seven in ten planning to launch a venture within three years.

stories.title: IIT Delhi alumnus details family debt repayment
stories.summary: Yash Garg, an IIT Delhi graduate, shared his experience of managing over 1 crore in family debt while working at Google. Garg documented his path from discovering the financial burden during his second year of university to building his own app business. Debt remains a persistent motivator.

stories.title: Teenager secures Y Combinator funding for missile startup
stories.summary: Henrijs Dandzbergs, a 16-year-old from Latvia, has dropped out of high school to launch Polemos Industries. The startup secured 4.4 crore from Y Combinator to develop low-cost, AI-guided missiles. The company aims to make precision weaponry more affordable for deployment via portable launchers.

stories.title: IIT Patna graduates pivot from humanoids to robotic joints
stories.summary: Two IIT Patna graduates founded Cosine Robots to build affordable humanoids before shifting focus to servo actuators. The Bengaluru-based startup raised 22.36 crore to manufacture these components. The founders concluded that the most lucrative opportunity in robotics lies in the parts that control movement.

stories.title: Defence startup attracts talent from global corporate roles
stories.summary: Apollyon Dynamics is drawing young professionals away from high-paying roles at firms like Goldman Sachs. The Hyderabad-based defence-tech startup, known for drone contracts with the Indian Army, is benefiting from a trend where employees prioritise purpose over corporate compensation packages. Career paths are currently undergoing a shift.

stories.title: Consumer platforms continue using dark patterns
stories.summary: A study by LocalCircles found that 74 percent of consumer companies that declared themselves free of dark patterns to the CCPA still deploy deceptive interface practices. These findings emerge despite new regulations set to take effect on January 1. Self-declaration appears to be a flexible administrative process.

stories.title: Investors struggle with AI-generated pitch decks
stories.summary: Venture capital firms report that AI-generated outreach is creating a deluge of cookie-cutter pitch decks and emails. Investors now cite a genuine human touch as the primary differentiator for identifying substance. The technology used to polish pitches is making it harder to find the founders behind them.

stories.title: Mathematician uses Claude to approach Riemann Hypothesis
stories.summary: Levent Alpöge used Anthropic’s Claude to develop a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis over six weeks. While independent researchers have verified the logical validity of the Lean code, the academic community is now considering how to evaluate breakthroughs produced by AI systems. Human comprehension remains a secondary requirement.

stories.title: India AI funding reaches 1.6 billion in nine months
stories.summary: Indian AI companies raised 1.6 billion in equity funding through September 2026, a 96 percent increase from the previous year, according to Tracxn. While total funding rose, the number of rounds fell by 42 percent. Fewer deals are now accounting for significantly more capital.
